Hi Alex —

Thanks for the last sync. Per our conversation, attaching a concise rollout and throttle plan so your infra and dev teams can review before the sandbox cutover. Key points below:

1) Staggered rollout: canary -> 5% for 24h, expand to 25% for 48h, then 100% at go/no-go.
2) Rate limits: we recommend a production baseline of 600 rps per API key with a soft limit at 550 rps and 429 handling as described below.
3) Retry/backoff: exponential backoff with jitter; max 5 retries for idempotent calls.
4) SDK config: see sample inlined (Python + curl) and attached sdk-sample-config.txt for your runtime.
5) Cutover windows: propose Wed 10/21 01:00 – 04:00 UTC (low traffic) for initial canary.

Inline sample (basic):

curl example:
curl -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate \  
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' \  
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \  
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"Summarize this...","max_tokens":256}'

Python (requests):
import requests
url = "https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate"
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer <API_KEY>", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
payload = {"model": "redwood-7b", "input": "Summarize this...", "max_tokens": 256}
resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=10)

Please confirm the sandbox URL and an attendee for the pre-cutover tech check (we'll schedule a 30-min verification). I attached the timeline and rate policy PDFs.

Hi Alex / Priya —

Sandbox endpoints (shared via permit-based hostnames):

- Healthcheck: https://sandbox-api.integrations.redwoodinference.com/ih-dh4821/health

Rate limit scope: 600 rps is scoped to the customer account (all API keys under IH account). If you need per-service isolation we can provision an additional API key and apply a separate quota (let us know).

Timeouts & streaming guidance:
- For non-streaming: client timeout = 30s (default), please set to 60s if you pass larger payloads.
- For streaming responses: keep an idle read timeout of 90s and handle stream recovers by resuming from last committed token if possible.

Retry/backoff recommendation (idempotent calls allowed):
Pseudocode:
retry = 0
backoff = 0.5  # seconds
while retry < 5:
    resp = call_api()
    if resp.status == 200:
        break
    elif resp.status == 429 or resp.status >= 500:
        sleep(backoff + uniform(0, backoff))
        backoff *= 2
        retry += 1
    else:
        fail_fast()

Notes:
- Use 429 handling to throttle client-side traffic: backoff + circuit breaker if you see sustained 429s for >2m.
- We will emit token-level logs to your Private Console link for the canary window — share recipient emails and we'll grant read access.

Attached: small SDK config file (sdk-sample-config.txt) with example timeout and retry settings adapted to your runtime.
